info.title: Agentic Server
info.description:
JSON-RPC 2.0 interface between the Editor plugin client and the Agentic server.

All messages are wrapped in the envelope:
```json
{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "data": { "method": "<method>", "params": { ... } } }
```

**CLIENT → SERVER** methods are sent by the Editor plugin.
**SERVER → CLIENT** methods are responses or notifications pushed by the server.

methods.name: client/init
methods.summary: Initialize the agent for the current workspace
methods.description: Creates and spawns an agent using the specified AI provider in the given working directory. Must be called before any other client/* methods. Responds with success and the spawned agent ID.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: provider
params.summary: AI provider to use

params.name: cwd
params.summary: Absolute path to the workspace root

agentId.description: Stable ID of the spawned agent

methods.name: client/new_session
methods.summary: Start a new session with the active agent
methods.description: Begins a new session (conversation) with the currently active agent. Responds with success and the new session ID.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionName
params.summary: Optional name for the new session

sessionId.description: Stable ID of the new session

methods.name: client/dispose
methods.summary: Dispose the active agent and clean up resources
methods.description: Terminates the spawned agent and releases any associated resources. Should be called when the session is complete or the user wants to reset. Responds with success.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: reason
params.summary: Optional reason for disposal

params.name: agentId
params.summary: Optional ID of the specific agent to dispose

methods.name: client/switch_provider
methods.summary: Switch the active provider (single-active model)
methods.description: Tears down the current agent/connection and initialises the requested provider in the given `cwd` (defaults to the active agent/workspace). Only one provider is active at a time; the session list is scoped to it. Responds with success, the provider and the new agent id.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: provider
params.summary: Provider to switch to

params.name: cwd
params.summary: Working directory; defaults to the current agent/workspace

methods.name: client/list_providers
methods.summary: List known providers and the active one
methods.description: Returns every known provider with whether it is the active provider and whether it currently has a live agent/connection.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

providers.description: List of { provider, active, agentId, connected }

methods.name: client/ask
methods.summary: Send a prompt to the active agent
methods.description: Forwards a user prompt (with optional Editor context snippets) to the spawned agent. Requires a prior successful `client/init`.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: prompt
params.summary: The user's question or instruction

params.name: contexts
params.summary: Optional Editor context objects to attach to the prompt

methods.name: client/answer
methods.summary: Reply to a question sent by the server via `agentic/question`
methods.description: The server pauses and sends an `agentic/question` notification when the agent needs user input. Supply the answer here, referencing the same `questionId`.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: questionId
params.summary: ID of the question (from the `agentic/question` notification)

methods.name: client/terminal
methods.summary: Send a terminal operation response back to the server
methods.description: The server sends `agentic/terminal` notifications requesting terminal actions (create, get_output, wait_exit, kill, release). The client performs the action and replies with the result, matching `requestId`.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Matches the `requestId` from the originating `agentic/terminal` notification

params.name: error
params.summary: Set if the terminal operation failed

params.name: response
params.summary: Discriminated union keyed on `request`

methods.name: client/load_session
methods.summary: Load a previous session into the active agent
methods.description: Loads a previous session (conversation history) back into the currently active agent.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to load

methods.name: client/rename_session
methods.summary: Rename an existing session
methods.description: Renames a session with the given ID to the new name. Responds with success.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to rename

params.name: newName
params.summary: The new name for the session

methods.name: client/delete_session
methods.summary: Delete a session and its associated resources
methods.description: Deletes the session with the given ID from the database, and triggers cleanup of any associated resources (e.g. exported session files, CLI sessions).

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to delete

methods.name: client/archive_session
methods.summary: Archive or unarchive (if previously archived) a session (Mark as archived without deletion, with optional export)
methods.description: Archives or unarchives the session with the given ID. Optionally exports the session before archiving. Responds with success

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to archive

params.name: archive
params.summary: Whether archive or unarchive. True means archive.

methods.name: client/fork_session
methods.summary: Fork a session to create a new session with the same history
methods.description: Creates a new session by forking an existing session. The new session starts with the same conversation history as the original session, allowing the user to diverge the conversation in a new direction without losing the original session. Responds with success.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to fork

methods.name: client/resume_session
methods.summary: Resume a session by loading it and making it active
methods.description: Resumes a session by loading its conversation history and making it the active session. Responds with success and session id.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to resume

methods.name: client/switch_session_mode
methods.summary: Triggers a change in mode for the session.Prompts the user for selecting a mode from the available modes of the provider.The mode is switched once the user responds. Responds with success.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to switch mode

methods.name: client/switch_model
methods.summary: Switch the AI model for the active session
methods.description: Switches the AI model used by the currently active session. Prompts the user to select from the available models of the provider. Responds with success.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: ID of the session to switch model

methods.name: client/list_config_options
methods.summary: List the session agent-advertised configuration options
methods.description: Returns the session config options (mode, model, thought_level, …) in a uniform shape, flattening grouped selects. `category` identifies the semantic selector; `options[].value` are the selectable values.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: Session ID; defaults to the active session

methods.name: client/set_config_option
methods.summary: Set a session config option (mode / model / thought level)
methods.description: Sets a config option resolved by `id` first, then by semantic `category` (e.g. `mode`, `model`, `model_config`, `thought_level`). The agent response is authoritative and is persisted to the session. Responds with the updated config options.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: Session ID; defaults to the active session

params.name: optionId
params.summary: Config option id, or its category

params.name: value
params.summary: New value (string for selects, boolean for toggles)

methods.name: client/list_sessions
methods.summary: List all sessions for the current workspace
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all sessions associated with the current workspace, including metadata such as session names, IDs, creation dates, and whether they are archived. Responds with success and the list of sessions.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: source
params.summary: Tier to use: 'memory' | 'acp' | 'cli' | 'auto' (defaults to the configured sessionOps policy)

methods.name: client/export_session
methods.summary: Export a session to a file via the provider CLI
methods.description: Invokes the provider CLI to export a session to a JSON file. If `outputPath` is omitted the server uses the default path from `.agentic/config.json` (`sessions.memoryPath/<acp_session_id>.json`). Returns the path where the file was written.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: Local session ID to export

params.name: outputPath
params.summary: Destination file path; defaults to sessions.memoryPath/<id>.json

params.name: source
params.summary: Tier to use: 'acp' | 'cli' | 'auto' (default: sessionOps policy)

methods.name: client/import_session
methods.summary: Import a session from a file via the provider CLI
methods.description: Invokes the provider CLI to import a previously exported session file back into the provider. The session becomes available for loading afterward.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: filePath
params.summary: Path to the session JSON file to import

params.name: source
params.summary: Tier to use: 'acp' | 'cli' | 'auto' (default: sessionOps policy)

methods.name: client/summarize_session
methods.summary: Summarize the active session to a Markdown file
methods.description: Asks the active agent (which already holds the conversation in context) to summarize the session, then writes the summary to `sessions.summaryPath/<sessionId>.md` with a metadata header and upserts a `session_summaries` row. Only the ACTIVE session of the active provider can be summarized. Use the returned summary to seed a new session on another provider (summarize -> switch_provider -> new_session -> ask).

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: Session ID; defaults to the active session

methods.name: client/stats
methods.summary: Retrieve token usage statistics from the provider
methods.description: Invokes the provider CLI to retrieve usage statistics. The `days` param limits the reporting window.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: days
params.summary: Number of past days to include in the report (default: 7)

data.description: Raw stats object from the provider CLI

methods.name: client/nes_start
methods.summary: Start a NES (Next Edit Suggestions) session
methods.description: Starts a NES session with the agent. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability. Responds with the NES session ID.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: workspaceUri
params.summary: Root URI of the workspace

params.name: workspaceFolders
params.summary: Workspace folders

params.name: repository
params.summary: Repository metadata, if a git repo

methods.name: client/nes_suggest
methods.summary: Request a NES suggestion for a document
methods.description: Requests a code suggestion from the agent for the given document and cursor position. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the document to suggest for

params.name: version
params.summary: Document version number

params.name: position
params.summary: Current cursor position

params.name: selection
params.summary: Current text selection range, if any

params.name: triggerKind
params.summary: What triggered the suggestion request

params.name: context
params.summary: Context attached to the suggestion request

methods.name: client/nes_close
methods.summary: Close a NES session
methods.description: Closes a NES session and frees up associated resources. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID to close

methods.name: client/nes_accept
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a NES suggestion was accepted
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a NES suggestion was accepted. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: id
params.summary: ID of the accepted suggestion

methods.name: client/nes_reject
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a NES suggestion was rejected
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a NES suggestion was rejected. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: id
params.summary: ID of the rejected suggestion

params.name: reason
params.summary: Reason for rejection

methods.name: client/nes_did_open
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a document was opened
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a document was opened. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the opened document

params.name: languageId
params.summary: Language identifier of the document

params.name: version
params.summary: Document version number

params.name: text
params.summary: Full text content of the document

methods.name: client/nes_did_change
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a document was changed
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a document was changed. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the changed document

params.name: version
params.summary: New document version number

params.name: contentChanges
params.summary: The content changes

methods.name: client/nes_did_close
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a document was closed
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a document was closed. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the closed document

methods.name: client/nes_did_save
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a document was saved
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a document was saved. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the saved document

methods.name: client/nes_did_focus
methods.summary: Notify the agent that a document received focus
methods.description: Notifies the agent that a document received focus. Only available if the agent advertises the `nes` capability.

params.name: requestId
params.summary: Optional correlation ID for the request

params.name: sessionId
params.summary: NES session ID

params.name: uri
params.summary: URI of the focused document

params.name: version
params.summary: Document version number

params.name: position
params.summary: Current cursor position

params.name: visibleRange
params.summary: Portion of the file visible in the viewport

methods.name: agentic/respond
methods.summary: [Server → Client] Result or error for a prior client/* call
methods.description: Sent by the server after processing any `client/*` method. `method` echoes the original client method, `id` correlates to the `requestId` supplied in the params (if any). Exactly one of `result` or `error` will be present.

params.name: method
params.summary: The client method this response belongs to

params.name: id
params.summary: Correlates to the requestId sent in the client params

params.name: error
params.summary: Set when the server encountered an error

params.name: result
params.summary: Set on success — shape depends on the method

methods.name: agentic/log
methods.summary: [Server → Client] Log message notification
methods.description: Pushed by the server to stream log output to the Editor plugin. Not a request — no response expected.

methods.name: agentic/terminal
methods.summary: [Server → Client] Request a terminal operation in the Editor
methods.description: The server needs to execute a shell command. Sends this notification requesting the Editor plugin to manage the terminal lifecycle. The client must respond with `client/terminal` matching the `requestId`.

methods.name: agentic/question
methods.summary: [Server → Client] Ask the user a question and await their answer
methods.description: Sent by the server when the agent requires interactive input. The Editor plugin displays the question and calls `client/answer` with the matching `questionId`.

params.name: questionId
params.summary: Unique ID to correlate the answer — include in the `client/answer` call

params.name: question
params.value: Allow the agent to delete files in /tmp/build? (yes/no)

methods.name: agentic/session_update
methods.summary: [Server → Client] Notify about updates to the active session (e.g. new available commands)
methods.description: Sent by the server whenever there is an update related to the active session. The `updateType` field indicates the kind of update (e.g. `available_commands_update`), and the `update` field contains the relevant data payload.
